concerns.text: SC-001 requires the success-rate difference to be statistically significant (p < 0.05), but T011’s verification only asserts that a `p_value` field exists; it does not enforce the p‑value threshold, thus the acceptance criterion is not validated.
SC-003 mandates a false‑positive retrieval rate < 20 %. T010’s verification only checks that the rate ≤ 1 (trivially true) and does not enforce the 20 % bound, weakening the acceptance criterion.

SC-003 also expects the false‑positive rate to be reported and bounded; T013’s CI check focuses on task‑type gains and does not verify the false‑positive rate threshold, leaving the criterion untested.

SC-004 specifies an overall experiment compute‑time limit of ≤ 30 hours, but no task includes a verification step that checks the aggregate runtime across all seeds and conditions, so this acceptance criterion is omitted.
